Experiência com Taleo Recruit

Experiência com Taleo Learn

Experiência com Oracle Payroll

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação II
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro , maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e a Fisia , distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades:


-Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;

- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

- SIEM: Experiência avançada em plataformas como Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security ou QRadar (criação de dashboards e KQL/SPL);

- Frameworks: Domínio do MITRE ATT&CK e NIST Incident Response;

- Threat Intel: Conhecimento em plataformas de TI (MISP, OpenCTI) e consumo de feeds de inteligência;

- Vulnerability Management: Operação de ferramentas como Tenable.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:
About SEW

SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing
  • Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms
  • 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations

SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.


Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.


The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.


This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.


Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.


Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.
  • Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations).
  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .


Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient:


We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Account Manager
description:
Remote | Full-time | Core hours: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM EST


Macedo Marketing is a performance-driven paid ads agency working with eCommerce and digital product brands in tier-one markets.


We’re hiring an Account Manager who can own client communication end-to-end, keep things calm when results fluctuate, and drive retention through clarity, trust, and solid execution.


About Macedo Marketing

  • We help eCommerce and digital product brands grow through paid advertising and creative strategy.
  • We’re direct, high standards, and process-driven. We care about results, but we also care about how we get them: honest communication, clear ownership, and no drama.
  • You’ll work closely with media buyers and creatives, but you’ll own the client relationship.


The Role

  • As an Account Manager, your job is to keep 15–20 clients aligned, confident, and moving forward. This is not a “smile and reassure” role. It’s a client-trust role.
  • You’ll lead client calls, handle day-to-day communication, translate performance into clear updates, and make sure the internal team is aligned on what matters most for each account.


Mission

Ensure clients feel confident, informed, and supported while achieving strong performance outcomes, leading to long-term retention and account growth.


Success looks like

  • Clients stay longer because they trust you
  • Issues get handled early, not after clients complain
  • Performance dips don’t turn into chaos
  • Clients understand what’s happening and what’s next
  • Upsell opportunities are spotted and surfaced responsibly


What You’ll Do

  • Own client communication and calls for your book of accounts (15–20 clients)
  • Run weekly or bi-weekly calls with clear structure, next steps, and accountability
  • Translate performance updates into clear, honest client communication


When performance dips:

  • Calmly explain the situation to the client with facts and context
  • Push internally for clarity and corrective action with the media buyer/creative team
  • Keep timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups clean and tracked
  • Make sure client questions don’t sit unanswered
  • Spot upsell and expansion opportunities and flag them internally
  • Collect testimonials / positive feedback at the right moments


This Will Be For You If…

  • You have 3+ years in account management / client success (agency experience is a strong plus)
  • You’re native or fully fluent in English and comfortable leading client calls
  • You’re calm under pressure and don’t take client stress personally
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented, and move fast on important tasks
  • You don’t overpromise to “make the client happy” — you align internally first
  • You’re curious about paid ads and want to deepen your understanding of Meta/Google fundamentals
  • You can handle a client load of 15–20 without dropping quality


Do Not Apply If…

  • You tend to procrastinate or take too long to handle time-sensitive issues
  • You leave client questions unanswered or avoid uncomfortable conversations
  • You “smooth things over” by making commitments without internal approval
  • You’re not interested in learning the basics of paid ads and how our delivery process works
  • You need constant supervision to stay organized


Why Join Macedo Marketing

  • Clear expectations and ownership: you’ll know what “good” tells like here
  • Direct access to leadership: fast decisions, no corporate layers
  • High standards, low drama: we care about performance and professionalism
  • 100% remote: work from anywhere, as long as you overlap 8 AM–4 PM EST
  • Growth path: this role can develop into a Senior AM / Client Lead position
  • Compensation is competitive and based on experience. We’ll ask for expectations in the application.


How to Apply

  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • We’ll send a short application form to shortlisted candidates
  • First interview for standout applications
  • We move quickly with the right people.

title: Consultor Security Cloud Azure SR (Projeto no México)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM em nuvem para detecção e resposta a ameaças).
  • Domínio em Kusto Query Language (KQL) para análise de eventos de segurança.
  • Experiência com automação de incidentes (Azure Logic Apps / Playbooks).
  • Vivência com segurança em ambientes Azure.
  • Conhecimento em automação e infraestrutura como código (PowerShell, Python, Terraform ou similares).
  • Horário comercial de segunda à sexta.
  • Idioma Espanhol Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais com o México).


Responsabilidades:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Cloud Security Specialist para atuar de forma estratégica na proteção de ambientes cloud e híbridos, garantindo alta resiliência e resposta eficiente a ameaças cibernéticas. No dia a dia, você será responsável por implementar e evoluir soluções de monitoramento e segurança utilizando o Microsoft Sentinel, criando dashboards, alertas e automações que elevem o nível de maturidade de segurança da organização. Além disso, irá atuar diretamente na correlação de eventos e investigação de incidentes, identificando riscos e conduzindo ações de resposta com agilidade e precisão.

Essa posição também terá papel fundamental na definição e aplicação de políticas de segurança no Azure, assegurando a proteção de workloads, identidades e redes. Esperamos alguém que vá além da operação, contribuindo com melhorias contínuas, automações inteligentes e boas práticas de segurança.

Se você gosta de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos, com alto nível de autonomia e foco em inovação, essa oportunidade é para você

title: Orçamentista
description:
Orçamentista (Estimator)


Objetivo da Função

Experiência na elaboração de orçamentos técnicos em projetos de fachadas e building envelope, com foco em sistemas de ACM e Attachment System, vidro arquitetônico e soluções de fachada. O profissional atuará diretamente na análise de documentos de projeto, levantamento de quantidades e preparação de propostas competitivas para novos projetos.

Responsabilidades
  • Analisar projetos, especificações técnicas e documentos de licitação.
  • Realizar levantamento de quantidades (takeoffs) para sistemas de fachada, incluindo ACM, Vidro arquitetônico e outros sistemas de envelope.
  • Preparar orçamentos detalhados considerando materiais e custos indiretos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de projetos e compras para obter cotações de fornecedores.
  • Avaliar diferentes soluções técnicas para otimizar custos e competitividade das propostas.
  • Preparar e organizar pré-propostas comerciais e documentação de suporte.
  • Participar da revisão de escopo e alinhamento técnico com clientes e parceiros quando necessário.
  • Manter banco de dados atualizado de custos, fornecedores e referências de projetos anteriores.
Requisitos
  • Experiência comprovada como orçamentista na indústria de fachadas de mais de 5 anos , preferencialmente com sistemas de ACM, vidro arquitetônico e sistemas de fachada em geral .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e projetos arquitetônicos.
  • Experiência com levantamento de quantidades (material takeoff).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e capacidade analítica.
  • Inglês avançado , pois todos os documentos e projetos e reuniões são em inglês.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com equipes técnicas e fornecedores.
  • O trabalho é 100% home-office.

title: Gestor de Tráfego Pago
description:
SUA INSCRIÇÃO SÓ SERÁ AVALIADA SE VOCÊ PREENCHER O FORMULÁRIO:


SOBRE A MDASS


Somos uma agência Google Partner Premier 2024 e 2025 em franco crescimento fundada no fim de 2022 e já atendemos mais de 150 clientes de diversos setores e tamanhos. Prezamos por uma gestão baseada no método CARE, exclusivo da MDASS, para gerir tráfego pago.


Saiba mais aqui:


QUEM ESTAMOS BUSCANDO?


O gestor de tráfego será responsável por planejar e executar estratégias de mídia paga para empresas de diferentes segmentos. Este profissional será um especialista em campanhas pagas, utilizando plataformas de publicidade online, análise de dados e otimização de funis de conversão para maximizar o retorno sobre o investimento (ROI) e alcançar os diferentes objetivos, de acordo com o negócio de cada cliente.


PRÉ-REQUISITOS

  • Disponibilidade de tempo para gerenciar até 10 clientes;
  • Conhecimentos hands-on em gestão de mídia paga, especialmente em Google Search e Meta Ads;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara;
  • Habilidade analítica para retirar insights através dos Dashboards, da ferramenta e internos.


Análise e Otimização:

  • Monitorar o desempenho das campanhas, analisar dados e identificar áreas de melhoria.
  • Implementar práticas de otimização contínua para maximizar a eficácia das campanhas.
  • Tomar decisões diárias para otimização de campanhas.


Atendimento diário com os clientes:

  • Preparação de relatórios regulares sobre o desempenho das campanhas.
  • Apresentação de estratégia, insights e melhorias.
  • Atencimento aos clientes via WhatsApp e/ou e-mail.


Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Experiência de mais de 3 anos com tráfego pago.
  • Certificados Google Ads;
  • Graduação na área de Adm, Marketing ou Comunicação.


Atuação 100% home office;

Tipo de contrato: PJ

title: Social Media Manager | TikTok & Instagram (EDM Focus)
description:
Role type: Full-time, fully remote

Salary Range: $1.8K – $2.5K/mo

Schedule: US business hours EDT


What We’re Looking For

This role is ideal for someone who goes beyond just posting content. We are looking for a candidate who understands how to build and grow pages from the ground up, with a strong focus on performance, engagement, and audience growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow around 5-8 social media pages (primarily TikTok and Instagram) focused on EDM content. (They will likely operate 5-8 pages individually but create content for the entire network, which is approximately 15-20 pages)
  • Develop and execute content strategies tailored to viral trends and audience engagement
  • Create, edit, and post high-performing short-form video content
  • Optimize page setup, bios, and overall positioning for maximum reach and growth
  • Identify trends in EDM, DJ culture, and viral audio to drive engagement
  • Monitor performance metrics and adjust strategy to improve growth and reach
  • Maintain consistency in posting schedules and content quality
  • Engage with audiences and help build an active community


Requirements

  • Proven experience managing and growing TikTok and/or Instagram pages
  • Strong understanding of Electronic Dance Music and its global audience
  • Demonstrated success in creating viral or high-performing content
  • Ability to optimize and scale social media pages from early stages
  • Skilled in video editing and short-form content creation
  • Strong understanding of social media algorithms, trends, and growth strategies
  • Self-driven, creative, and results-oriented


Nice to Have

  • Experience managing multiple pages simultaneously
  • Background in music, DJ culture, or entertainment content
  • Familiarity with analytics and performance tracking tools


Benefits

  • Client Relationship : You will be directly working with the client. This means that you will communicate with the client, provide services, and address any client-related matters independently.
  • Payments : All payments for your services will be handled by the client. Elevate and Delegate is not involved in processing your payroll. Your salary will directly go to you. 
  • Vacation Leaves and Holidays : While we may have recommendations or guidelines regarding vacation leaves and holidays, the decision is entirely at the discretion of the client. You are expected to align your schedule with the client’s business needs and any specific policies or preferences they may have in this regard.

title: Senior Information Security Analyst
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Senior Security Analyst OR Senior Information Security Analyst (GRC)
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Support security governance, risk assessments, and audit activities (ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc.)
  • Monitor security metrics and identify compliance gaps or risks
  • Track and drive remediation of security issues with application and platform teams
  • Ensure security controls are effectively designed and implemented
  • Prepare reports and communicate risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance security processes and controls

Required Skills and Experience

  • Experience in information security, IT risk, compliance, or audit roles
  • Strong understanding of frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, or similar
  • Experience supporting audits, assurance activities, and remediation efforts
  • Familiarity with security metrics, control monitoring, and SLA-based compliance
  • Experience working with system or application owners to resolve security issues
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills for risk and compliance tracking
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Knowledge of cloud, SaaS, or enterprise platforms
  • Hands-on experience with security tools such as Panaseer, Checkmarx, or Wiz

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CRISC, or CISSP (or in progress)
  • Experience in regulated or data-driven environments
  • Familiarity with privacy, data protection, or third-party risk management

title: Especialista de Implantação SAP PY
description:
Na ADP, somos movidos pelo seu sucesso. Envolvemos seus talentos e perspectivas únicos. Acolhemos suas ideias para fazer as coisas de modo diferente e melhor. Nós apoiamos seus esforços para realizar, aprender e crescer. Se o sucesso te motiva, você pertence à ADP.

Nos esforçamos para que cada interação seja motivada pelos nossos valores CENTRAIS: Conhecimento e Visão, Integridade é Tudo, Excelência na Prestação de Serviços, Inovação Inspiradora, Cada Pessoa Conta, Orientação a Resultados e Responsabilidade Social.

Nossa cultura acolhe diversas perspectivas e cria um lugar onde as carreiras podem florescer. Nós respeitamos e valorizamos as diferenças com oportunidades iguais de emprego, independentemente de raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, cultura, deficiência ou status social.

Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso. Faça parte do nosso time!

RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO


Como Consultor SAP, você atuará como facilitador entre a equipe de implementação e os clientes para entender melhor suas necessidades de negócios.

Atuará também como mentor ou treinador de parceiros. Preparará especificações funcionais, incluindo detalhes sobre design e configuração.

FUNÇÕES:


  • Resolver os problemas reportados nos SLAs.
  • Configuração do SAP HCM PY para folha de pagamento Brasil, Argentina, Colombia e Costa Rica
  • Fornecer aos clientes o status das implementações
  • Guarde a documentação do cliente
  • Fornecer suporte a aplicativos
  • Reunir-se com clientes sempre que necessário
  • Aplicar conhecimento funcional relevante específico do país para potencializar o serviço focado no cliente
  • Realizar testes unitários
  • Fornecer documentação

REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência em implementação SAP HCM, módulo de folha de pagamento (PY)
  • Ensino superior completo
  • Inglês em nível avançado para conversação


O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.”

title: Performance Marketing Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Paid Media Marketing Specialist to drive high-quality leads by creating, managing, and measuring Digital Marketing campaigns across Google, YouTube, social, and other relevant channels.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on, independent strategic thinker who brings deep expertise in running digital marketing programs and developing digital marketing assets (with our designer) within B2B SaaS organizations.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive, this isn’t the role for you. But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own:

  • Develop programs and strategies for customer acquisition, retention, and expansion through multiple channels, including search, PMAX, social, retargeting, content (written and video), and more.
  • Define KPIs and implement measurement, analytics, benchmarking, and reporting methods to gauge success for marketing channels, campaigns, and initiatives.
  • Drive continual improvements in lead conversion rates and revenue close rates.
  • Continue to scale our marketing efforts and take primary responsibility for exceeding our KPIs for each quarter.
  • Work closely with the overall Marketing team to define required assets such as content, images, video, etc.

Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:

We're looking for an experienced, self-sufficient Email & SMS Marketing Specialist who can fully own the strategy, copy, design, and execution of retention campaigns across multiple accounts.


Role Overview:

We're looking for a full-stack lifecycle marketer—someone who can strategize, write, design, and execute high-performing email and SMS campaigns end-to-end. You’ll be the go-to expert responsible for delivering results across Klaviyo, Postscript, and other tools, and will manage the full lifecycle marketing function for several eCommerce brands.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own Campaign Creation and Client Calendar Planning From A–Z : Develop a campaign calendar for brands assigned to you and execute email and SMS campaigns including strategy, segmentation, copywriting, design layout, scheduling, and testing.


  • Build Automations & Flows: Set up and maintain high-converting flows such as Welcome, Abandon Cart, Browse Abandonment, Winback, Post-Purchase, etc.


  • Design Beautiful, On-Brand Emails: Use Figma or another editor of your choice (or custom code if needed) to design emails that look great on mobile and desktop—and convert.


  • Write Strategic, On-Brand Copy: Craft subject lines, preview text, and body copy that aligns with the brand voice and drives action.


  • Run A/B Tests & Optimize: Continuously test and refine subject lines, send times, content blocks, and CTAs to improve performance.


  • Audience Segmentation & List Growth: Manage lists and build smart segments to personalize messaging and improve deliverability.


  • Analytics & Reporting: Monitor and report on key KPIs (open rate, click rate, CVR, unsubscribes, revenue per recipient, etc.) and use insights to inform future strategy.


  • Client Communication: Hop on strategy calls or send Looms explaining performance, roadmap, and ideas to clients.


Who You Are:

  • Fluent verbal and written English copywriting skills


  • An experience retention & lifecycle marketer who can handle everything from strategy, copy, design, build, test, and optimize.


  • 3+ years of experience in email/SMS marketing for eCommerce brands


  • Fluent in Klaviyo and at least one major SMS platform (Postscript, Attentive, etc.)


  • Strong portfolio showing high-performing campaigns (with clear results)


  • Excellent design eye—clean layouts, great typography, conversion-focused styling


  • Strong copywriting skills—can write clear, engaging, persuasive emails for a variety of brand voices


  • Ability to manage multiple clients and timelines without dropping the ball


  • Agency experience preferred


  • Bonus: HTML/CSS familiarity for custom email tweaks


Why Work With Us:

  • Work with top-tier 8 & 9 figure DTC brands


  • Flexible remote work schedule


  • Clear systems and team support, but lots of autonomy


  • Direct impact on performance and client growth


  • Growth potential into leadership or strategy roles


Compensation:

  • $1500 - $6000 USD per month


To be considered for this role please apply and follow/connect with our CEO (Andrew Giessinger):

title: Banco de Talentos GFT - QA Automação
description:
Banco de Talentos | QA Automação


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de QA com foco em Automação de Testes, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua dos processos de testes.

O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Atuar na garantia de qualidade em aplicações web, APIs e, em alguns casos, mobile;

  • Experiência com automação de testes (web, APIs e/ou mobile);
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python ou similares;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com testes de APIs (Postman, RestAssured ou similares);
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de testes (pirâmide de testes, testes unitários, integração, E2E);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência com automação de testes mobile (ex: Appium) será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em testes de performance e/ou segurança é um diferencial;
  • Certificações em qualidade de software (como ISTQB) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Olhar crítico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Pensamento analítico e foco em qualidade;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Curiosidade e interesse por novas ferramentas e práticas de testes;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.


Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant

Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting

We are looking for contractor support to strengthen creative workflow operations. This person would not be focused on creative production itself, but on helping requests move efficiently through intake, scoping, setup, and handoff, while also supporting workflow improvements in Asana .

description:
Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.


About Apex Brands:

We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:

We're looking for an experienced, self-sufficient Email & SMS Marketing Specialist who can fully own the strategy, copy, design, and execution of retention campaigns across multiple accounts.


Role Overview:

We're looking for a full-stack lifecycle marketer—someone who can strategize, write, design, and execute high-performing email and SMS campaigns end-to-end. You’ll be the go-to expert responsible for delivering results across Klaviyo, Postscript, and other tools, and will manage the full lifecycle marketing function for several eCommerce brands.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own Campaign Creation and Client Calendar Planning From A–Z : Develop a campaign calendar for brands assigned to you and execute email and SMS campaigns including strategy, segmentation, copywriting, design layout, scheduling, and testing.


  • Build Automations & Flows: Set up and maintain high-converting flows such as Welcome, Abandon Cart, Browse Abandonment, Winback, Post-Purchase, etc.


  • Design Beautiful, On-Brand Emails: Use Figma or another editor of your choice (or custom code if needed) to design emails that look great on mobile and desktop—and convert.


  • Write Strategic, On-Brand Copy: Craft subject lines, preview text, and body copy that aligns with the brand voice and drives action.


  • Run A/B Tests & Optimize: Continuously test and refine subject lines, send times, content blocks, and CTAs to improve performance.


  • Audience Segmentation & List Growth: Manage lists and build smart segments to personalize messaging and improve deliverability.


  • Analytics & Reporting: Monitor and report on key KPIs (open rate, click rate, CVR, unsubscribes, revenue per recipient, etc.) and use insights to inform future strategy.


  • Client Communication: Hop on strategy calls or send Looms explaining performance, roadmap, and ideas to clients.


Who You Are:

  • Fluent verbal and written English copywriting skills


  • An experience retention & lifecycle marketer who can handle everything from strategy, copy, design, build, test, and optimize.


  • 3+ years of experience in email/SMS marketing for eCommerce brands


  • Fluent in Klaviyo and at least one major SMS platform (Postscript, Attentive, etc.)


  • Strong portfolio showing high-performing campaigns (with clear results)


  • Excellent design eye—clean layouts, great typography, conversion-focused styling


  • Strong copywriting skills—can write clear, engaging, persuasive emails for a variety of brand voices


  • Ability to manage multiple clients and timelines without dropping the ball


  • Agency experience preferred


  • Bonus: HTML/CSS familiarity for custom email tweaks


Why Work With Us:

  • Work with top-tier 8 & 9 figure DTC brands


  • Flexible remote work schedule


  • Clear systems and team support, but lots of autonomy


  • Direct impact on performance and client growth


  • Growth potential into leadership or strategy roles

Nos esforçamos para que cada interação seja motivada pelos nossos valores CENTRAIS: Conhecimento e Visão, Integridade é Tudo, Excelência na Prestação de Serviços, Inovação Inspiradora, Cada Pessoa Conta, Orientação a Resultados e Responsabilidade Social.

Nossa cultura acolhe diversas perspectivas e cria um lugar onde as carreiras podem florescer. Nós respeitamos e valorizamos as diferenças com oportunidades iguais de emprego, independentemente de raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, cultura, deficiência ou status social.

Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso. Faça parte do nosso time!

RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO


Como Consultor SAP, você atuará como facilitador entre a equipe de implementação e os clientes para entender melhor suas necessidades de negócios.

Atuará também como mentor ou treinador de parceiros. Preparará especificações funcionais, incluindo detalhes sobre design e configuração.

FUNÇÕES:


  • Resolver os problemas reportados nos SLAs.
  • Configuração do SAP HCM PY para folha de pagamento Brasil, Argentina, Colombia e Costa Rica
  • Fornecer aos clientes o status das implementações
  • Guarde a documentação do cliente
  • Fornecer suporte a aplicativos
  • Reunir-se com clientes sempre que necessário
  • Aplicar conhecimento funcional relevante específico do país para potencializar o serviço focado no cliente
  • Realizar testes unitários
  • Fornecer documentação

REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência em implementação SAP HCM, módulo de folha de pagamento (PY)
  • Ensino superior completo
  • Inglês em nível avançado para conversação


O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.”

description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções Azure/.Net Core


Descrição:


Estamos buscando um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções em Nuvem com foco em aplicações nativas em nuvem no Azure e em aplicações de IA. Esta posição, voltada para o cliente, utilizará toda a sua experiência técnica prática. Abrangendo design, construção/codificação e operações para remover obstáculos técnicos e desafios de adoção, liderando e orquestrando todos os recursos técnicos necessários para a evolução e a conclusão do projeto, com o melhor sucesso possível para o cliente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetura e desenvolvimento de IA com IA Copilot Studio e Microsoft Foundry;
  • Especialista em Arquitetura NET Framework/.NET Core usando a linguagem C# e Visual Studio.
  • Experiência técnica em escala corporativa com infraestruturas de nuvem e híbridas, designs de arquitetura, migrações e gestão de tecnologia com Cloud Azure.
  • Experiência com arquitetura escalável usando serviços de nuvem para aplicações, como serviços do Azure: App Service, API Management, tecnologias serverless, orquestração de contêineres (por exemplo, Kubernetes, Cloud Foundry etc.), frameworks de microsserviços, SDKs etc.
  • Práticas de desenvolvimento de software como DevOps e pipelines de ferramentas de CI/CD (por exemplo, Jenkins, Spinnaker, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Visual Studio).
  • Arquitetura e troubleshooting do Internet Information Services (IIS).
  • Habilidades de apresentação técnica e com foco no cliente, com alto nível de conforto para falar com públicos grandes e pequenos.
  • Diagnóstico e resolução de problemas relacionados à implantação de aplicações e infraestrutura em ambientes on-premises/nuvem.
  • Experiência e entendimento de grandes portfólios de aplicações em ambientes corporativos (incluindo migração de workloads on-premises para a nuvem).
  • Experiência técnica em escala corporativa com hospedagem de aplicações nativas em nuvem, abrangendo design de software, desenvolvimento, implantação e refatoração/migrações de aplicações.
  • Adapta metodologias e aplica governança para identificar, comunicar e minimizar riscos de negócio e técnicos (por exemplo, Well-Architected Framework, Enterprise Scale Landing Zone, Cloud Adoption Framework). title: Business System Analyst
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 15-22k BRL/mo.


Required Skills & Experience


• 5+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst or Systems BA

• Extensive experience writing technical requirements for system design and modernization efforts • Strong Jira experience, including creating user stories and development tickets

• Experience using Claude Code or other AI tools to support system modernization

• Ability to lead discovery sessions, ask probing questions, and provide thoughtful recommendations


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience working within education technology or healthcare-related applications


Job Description

title: Business Development Manager – Industrial Market
description:
Hikvision is the world's largest supplier of video surveillance products and solutions. The company specializes in video surveillance technology, as well as designing and manufacturing a full line of innovative CCTV and video surveillance products. Since its establishment in 2001, Hikvision has quickly achieved a leading worldwide market position in the security industry.


Hikvision possesses the world's largest R&D team and state-of-art manufacturing facilities; both allow Hikvision’s customers the benefit of world-class products that are designed with cutting-edge technology. The infrared thermography product line ranges from sensors, modules to full-featured products.


Business Development Manager – Industrial Market


Country： Brazil

The Business Development Manager – Industrial Market should have large experience for developing Industrial market by approaching and building solid relationship with both Distributors and End Users.

The key attributes and expectations of a good Business Development Manager are:


•Great business sense and market sense

•Massive customer resource regarding industrial market

•Great communication skills

•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred

•A positive attitude

•Great negotiation skills

•Initiative, Honesty and Integrity


Hikvision therefore requires the Business Development manager to act as the ambassador of the company and brand, delivering the following key tasks:


•Develop/Manager Industrial market, and carry out market research, competitor and customer surveys

•Find potential business opportunities and business growth points

•Approaching and establishing new, solid and long-term relationships with distributors and end users

•Presentation of the solution to potential customers

•Support marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events.

•Work closely with colleagues in the regional sales team

•Perform lobbying in associations and interest groups.

•Assist consultants to specify projects

•Position HIKMICRO as the preferred product for consultants.

•Prepare reports required by the management.


Your Profile:


•Experience in the industrial market.

•Proven negotiation skills on cooperate level.

•Being open minded to working in a multi-cultural company.

•Being self-driven and ambitious to be part of a winning culture.

•The knowledge of Infrared Thermography or Flow Meter or Pressure Transmitter or Level Meter is preferred

•Strong communication skills in English，both oral and written

•Solid in Outlook and related products.

title: Sr. Mainframe Developer (COBOL)
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Sr. Mainframe COBOL Developer to join an international project supporting a US client in the life insurance industry. This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to the maintenance, enhancement, and migration of critical mainframe-based insurance administration systems.



Main Challenges:


  • Maintain and enhance legacy mainframe systems written in Assembler and COBOL , working with VSAM file structures
  • Support and develop applications on the Ingenium platform (COBOL/DB2)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across multiple mainframe environments
  • Support ongoing data extraction and migration efforts toward a third-party administrator (TPA)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure system reliability, performance, and continuity
  • Provide knowledge transfer and documentation to preserve institutional knowledge


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience in mainframe development experience with COBOL (critical)
  • Hands-on experience with IBM Mainframe Assembler programming on z/OS
  • Proven background in life insurance or annuities systems (policy administration, claims, or billing)
  • Experience working with VSAM file structures on mainframe environments
  • Hands-on experience with DB2 on IBM mainframe
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in legacy/production environments
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively in English with US-based client teams


Preferred Background:


  • Familiarity with Ingenium or similar insurance administration platforms
  • Experience with data migration or system conversion projects
  • Exposure to CICS Transaction Gateway and Unix environments
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent


This role is especially relevant for professionals who have worked in life insurance mainframe environments, supported legacy system modernization, and are comfortable taking ownership of a broad range of responsibilities in a direct, fast-paced team culture.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

O profissional atuará com foco principal em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade, aderência às regras locais (Brasil e LATAM) e alinhamento com diretrizes globais. O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

Consultor(a) SAP VIM


  • Data de Início: Imediata
  • Contrato de Trabalho: PJ ou Cooperativa
  • Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado
  • Local de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário de Trabalho: Comercial
  • Taxa hora: A ser negociada


O que buscamos?


Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) de Suporte a Aplicações SAP experiente, especializado em Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) e SAP Central Invoice Management (CIM), uma aplicação nativa em nuvem projetada para o SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.


Esta função tem como foco fornecer suporte de aplicação de Nível 2 / Nível 3 para o processamento completo (end-to-end) de faturas de fornecedores, garantindo operações estáveis, tratamento eficiente de exceções e melhoria contínua dos processos em ambientes SAP integrados.


Conhecimentos e Competências Necessárias:


  • Experiência com S/4 HANA e SAP Activate;
  • Inglês avançado (Mandatório);
  • Experiência em suporte a aplicações SAP, com forte atuação em Vendor Invoice Management;
  • Experiência prática (hands-on) no suporte ao SAP Central Invoice Management (CIM) em ambiente produtivo;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de ITSM.


Responsabilidades:


  • Suporte a Aplicações & Gestão de Incidentes:

Fornecer suporte a aplicações para SAP Vendor Invoice Management e SAP Central Invoice Management (CIM) em múltiplas unidades de negócio e códigos de empresa.


  • Solucionar problemas e resolver incidentes relacionados a:

Recebimento de faturas (invoice ingestion);

Extração via OCR e erros de validação;

Problemas de status de faturas;

Workflow, aprovações e tratamento de exceções.

Realizar análise de causa raiz (root cause analysis) e implementar correções sustentáveis em conformidade com SLAs e processos ITIL.

Oferecer suporte em períodos críticos de negócio sob demanda.


  • Configuração & Melhorias no CIM:

Configurar e dar suporte às definições de processamento de faturas no SAP Central Invoice Management, incluindo:

Tipos de fatura e serviços de processamento

Regras de negócio e validações

Configuração de workflows e aprovações

Apoiar melhorias e solicitações de mudança relacionadas à eficiência, conformidade e automação do processamento de faturas.


  • Colaborar com equipes ABAP e de integração para:

Interfaces entre o CIM e sistemas SAP backend

Tratamento de erros e monitoramento de fluxos de entrada de faturas


  • Integração & Processamento de Faturas de Entrada:

Dar suporte às integrações de faturas provenientes de:

SAP S/4HANA

Sistemas externos

Monitorar e dar suporte aos agendamentos de importação de faturas.

Auxiliar na resolução de falhas de integração e inconsistências de dados entre o CIM e sistemas ERP conectados.


  • Colaboração com Finanças & Negócio:

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de Contas a Pagar, Finanças e Compras.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante a entrevista técnica com o cliente.

description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 40 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • First official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 40 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Part-time | Full-time | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Monitor local trends and market information in the local language region, synchronize with headquarters, and provide localized perspective analysis.

  • Familiar with the culture, social platforms, and media ecosystem of the local language region; capable of PR content writing and market promotion optimization; understands local logistics and business coordination processes.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to efficiently connect headquarters, local media, partners, and clients.
  • Proactive thinking and execution ability, with strong delivery, business negotiation skills, and responsibility.
  • Knowledge of the Portuguese-speaking region’s Web3 ecosystem, with successful PR collaboration or market promotion cases in vertical media.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, or Chinese and Portuguese is essential.


Working at BingX


  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that.

The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback
  • Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing — workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting
  • Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting
  • Work closely with the rest of the marketing team on campaign development
  • Monitor and improve email deliverability on an ongoing basis
  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate, personalize at scale, and move faster
  • Report on what's working and what isn't — with actual numbers


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years in lifecycle, retention, or marketing ops at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep HubSpot expertise — you should be able to build complex workflows without a tutorial
  • Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation tooling
  • AI-native: you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically to how
  • Strong instincts on B2B customer journeys, PQLs, and usage-based growth models
  • You can write a decent email — you don't need to be a copywriter, but you shouldn't need one for every send
  • Comfortable owning work independently without a lot of hand-holding


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience managing or scaling a lifecycle program from early-stage to mature
  • Familiarity with deliverability tools like MX Toolbox, Postmaster Tools, or similar


ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

They're remote, operationally lean, and genuinely open to how AI changes the way marketing works. If you want to build something real without a lot of bureaucracy, this is a good fit.

title: SAP Architect
description:
SAP/Integration Solution Architect

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long Term Contract


Requirements

Education:

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
  • Preferred: Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field


Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in SAP technical architecture and integration development
  • Extensive hands-on experience with SAP integration technologies (PI/PO, CPI, Cloud Platform Integration)
  • Strong experience with SAP modules (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, SAP BTP)
  • Proven track record of designing and implementing complex integration solutions in enterprise environments
  • Experience with APIs, Web Services (REST, SOAP), OData, and middleware platforms
  • Strong understanding of SAP data structures, IDocs, BAPIs, RFCs
  • Experience with SAP landscape architecture and system connectivity
  • Demonstrated experience leading integration projects from design through implementation


Preferred Experience:

  • SAP certification in integration technologies (SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP Cloud Platform Integration, PI/PO certification)
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud and hybrid integration scenarios
  • Knowledge of Dell Boomi, MuleSoft, or other enterprise integration platforms
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and cloud-native integration
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines for integration development
  • Experience with SAP Fiori, UI5, and front-end integration
  • Background in Agile/Scrum methodologiesExperience in consumer goods, manufacturing, or retail industries
  • Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2)


Technical Knowledge & Skills:

  • Expert knowledge of SAP integration technologies (PI/PO, CPI, BTP, Integration Suite)
  • Deep understanding of integration patterns, protocols, and best practices
  • Proficiency in SAP ABAP programming and debugging
  • Strong knowledge of XML, JSON, XSLT, and data transformation techniques
  • Experience with API management and microservices architecture
  • Understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman)
  • Knowledge of database concepts and SQL
  • Security and authentication protocols (OAuth, SAML, SSL)
  • System performance tuning and optimization techniques
  • Version control systems (Git, SVN) and change management processes


Soft Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with ability to address complex technical challenges
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels
  • Leadership and mentoring capabilities to guide development teams and foster technical excellence
  • Strategic thinking with ability to align technical solutions with business objectives and long-term enterprise architecture
  • Stakeholder management and collaboration skills across global teams and multiple time zones
  • Strong documentation and presentation skills for technical and executive audiences
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage priorities effectively
  • Change management and adaptability in dynamic project environments with evolving requirements
  • Customer-focused mindset with commitment to delivering high-quality solutions
  • Proactive and self-motivated with strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Continuous improvement mindset with focus on innovation and staying current with technology trends

description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Qualidade técnicas:

• Domínio de Azure Data Services: Experiência prática com IaaS (SQL em VMs) e PaaS (Azure SQL Database, Managed Instance).

• Linguagens e Automação: Domínio de T-SQL e proficiência em scripts de automação (PowerShell ou Python).

• Monitoramento e Troubleshooting: Conhecimento em ferramentas como Azure Monitor, Query Store e SQL Profiler.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.


Where you Fit In:


As a Senior QA Engineer , you are a key technical leader within Quality Engineering. You own quality across complex, mission-critical systems and play an active role in shaping automation standards, testing strategy, and long-term reliability.


You go beyond execution — influencing decisions and ensuring quality is embedded into the engineering lifecycle.


You are a highly technical, systems-oriented QA professional with strong automation expertise.

You understand how systems interact across the stack and think proactively about risk, scalability, and long-term maintainability. You don’t just validate features — you anticipate failure points, analyze trade-offs, and design quality solutions accordingly.

You are confident leading discussions, mentoring others, and raising the bar for engineering excellence.


The impact you will have:


  • Troubleshoot critical issues across environments and support root cause analysis
  • Reduce flakiness and improve test stability and execution reliability
  • Contribute to roadmap discussions and long-term quality vision
  • Identify strategic quality risks and advocate for prioritization
  • Mentor other QA engineers and strengthen onboarding and technical standards
  • Continuously improving the Automation Framework and overall automation coverage
  • Lead testing strategy for complex, cross-team systems.


What we’re looking for:


Technical

  • Strong experience in automation testing
  • Advanced English
  • Understanding of system architecture and cross-team dependencies
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the full stack
  • Experience improving automation reliability and non-functional coverage
  • Strategic thinking around scalability and long-term maintainability.


Execution

  • Proven ability to lead complex, multi-team initiatives
  • Breaks down large challenges into structured execution plans
  • Owns quality from design through production
  • Aligns technical decisions with broader company goals.


Collaboration & Influence

  • Clearly communicates risks, trade-offs, and system impact
  • Act as a mentor to teammates and contributes to team growth
  • Builds consensus and leads by example.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.


Key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a deep, system-level understanding of the entire product architecture to ensure comprehensive and thorough testing across all layers.
  • Proactively identify, coordinate, and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure seamless end-to-end quality and delivery.
  • Employ extensive testing experience across Native Mobile Applications, Backend services, and Front-end systems .
  • Design and execute advanced testing techniques, including thorough Monkey Testing , and champion the introduction of Chaos Engineering practices into the development pipeline.
  • Identify tasks/dependencies/risks during backlog grooming/planning.
  • Provide reasonable test estimates and feedback on priorities.
  • Fully understand and actively provide ways to improve project/solution level test strategy/test design principles.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of testing tools/techniques/strategies.
  • Contribute effectively to the development of a project's test strategy and automation suite.
  • Collaborate with developers/business analysts for feedback into software design and tests.
  • Assist with effective test reporting and contribute to ensuring the CI/CD pipeline has thorough test coverages.
  • Contribute effectively to utilize an automation framework for testing and the creation of test scripts (different automation test layers such as UI or API Acceptance Tests).
  • Identify gaps in the current automation suite and help prioritize those / get them into the backlog.
  • Investigate and assist in diagnosing issues.
  • Share testing/product knowledge with other team members.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with a focus on large, complex, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience as a coordinator or leader managing QA activities across multiple, interdependent teams and technical domains (Mobile, Web, Backend).
  • Deep expertise in various testing methodologies, including mandatory experience with Monkey Testing and/or a strong theoretical or practical background in Chaos Engineering/Resilience Testing.
  • Mandatory professional experience testing: Native Mobile Applications (iOS and/or Android), Distributed Backend/Microservices Platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and understanding of how cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) impact system testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in complex frontend web applications.
  • Automation is a plus; experience programming or scripting in at least one modern language (e.g., Python or Ruby).


What we offer

  • 100% remote in Poland, Romania, Ukraine, or Brazil.
  • B2B Contract.
  • English classes.

title: Gerente Suínocultura
description:
Garantir a produção eficiente, sustentável e de alta qualidade nas granjas (creches e engorda), por meio da gestão estratégica de pessoas, processos e recursos, assegurando o bem-estar animal, a sanidade do plantel e rentabilidade do negócio, em conformidade com as normas técnicas ambientais e de biossegurança. Dominar o manejo reprodutivo (cobertura, inseminação, diagnóstico de gestação), de crescimento, engorda e nutrição animal, sanidade e medicamentos.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e garantir a execução de todas as etapas: reprodução (cobertura, inseminação artificial, diagnóstico de gestação), controle de ciclo estral, taxas de fertilidade, parto e desmame, gestão de matrizes e leitões. Maternidade , creche e terminação (manejo nutricional por fase, conversão alimentar e ganho de peso, estratégias para redução de perdas, planejamento de abate).
  • Monitorizar indicadores zootécnicos (taxa de parto, mortalidade, ganho de peso, conversão alimentar).
  • Garantir cumprimento das metas de produção e qualidade.
  • Implementar e garantir protocolos sanitários e de vacinação.
  • Controlar uso correto de medicamentos veterinários.
  • Prevenir surtos e agir rapidamente em casos de doença.
  • Assegurar cumprimentos de normas de biossegurança.
  • Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe operacional.
  • Distribuir atividades e garantir disciplina operacional.
  • Acompanhar desempenho e engajamento.
  • Construir cultura de responsabilidade e cuidado.
  • Controlar custos (ração, medicamentos, mão de obra e insumos).
  • Otimizar uso de recursos e reduzir desperdícios.
  • Garantir rentabilidade da operação.
  • Reportar resultados a diretoria com indicadores.
  • Preparar granjas para auditorias e certificações.
  • Garantir bem-estar animal.
  • Atuar junto com fornecedores.

description:
