title: Desenvolvedor de software em teste
description:
Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium and Playwright for mobile and API layers
  • Build and execute test cases mapped to JIRA user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Conduct functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing across Android and iOS
  • File and manage defects in JIRA, providing detailed reproduction steps and severity assessment
  • Support parallel test execution and help triage automation results from CI/CD runs
  • Work alongside Mobile developers in a collaborative, shift-left testing approach
  • Maintain and improve test data management strategies for consistent test execution
  • Provide QA sign-off on user stories prior to sprint completion
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement discussions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 5+ years of QA automation or SDET experience
  • Proficiency with Selenium WebDriver and Playwright
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript
  • Experience with mobile automation using Appium and/or native testing frameworks
  • Proven use of JIRA for test management, defect tracking, and sprint participation
  • Familiarity with CI/CD integration for automated test suites
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work on multiple test workstreams simultaneously
  • Solid understanding of software QA methodologies and Agile practices
  • Working knowledge of Test Driven Development (TDD) principles and experience contributing to TDD-based workflows
  • Experience with parallel test execution strategies and grid-based testing (Selenium Grid)
  • Background in performance or load testing for mobile backends
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and pull-request-based QA review workflows


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

title: PESSOA DIRETORA DE UNIDADE - FEIRA DE SANTANA
description:
Nós somos a Cogna, a maior e mais completa empresa de serviços educacionais do país.

Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos.

Entre nossas marcas estão Anglo, Red Balloon e Anhanguera, além das editoras Ática, Saraiva, Scipione, que refletem a diversidade e a força do nosso ecossistema educacional.

Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si.

Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Gerenciar a equipe da unidade, garantindo a efetividade dos processos e a qualidade dos serviços prestados

- Planejar e executar estratégias para o alcance dos objetivos da unidade, visando o crescimento e a rentabilidade

- Gerenciar os recursos financeiros da unidade, elaborando e acompanhando o orçamento

- Gerenciar projetos e processos, buscando a melhoria contínua e a eficiência operacional

- Negociar com fornecedores e parceiros, visando a obtenção de melhores condições comerciais

- Gerenciar contratos e acordos com clientes e fornecedores, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações

- Garantir a qualidade dos serviços prestados pela unidade, implementando e monitorando processos e indicadores

- Gerenciar os riscos da unidade, identificando e mitigando potenciais problemas

Requisitos e qualificações:

- Graduação em Administração

- Pós-Graduação em Gestão de Negócios

- MBA em Gestão Empresarial

- Cursos de Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas

- Conhecimento em Lean Six Sigma

- Experiência comprovada em gestão de pessoas, liderança, gestão financeira, planejamento estratégico, gestão de projetos, gestão de processos, negociação, gestão de contratos, gestão de qualidade e gestão de riscos

- Habilidade em comunicação, trabalho em equipe, resiliência, flexibilidade e proatividade

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.

  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.
  • Seguro de Vida: Este beneficio é compulsório, a todos os colaboradores CLT, sem custo, e estão inclusos na apólice de seguro, a partir da sua data de admissão.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Plant Manager
description:
We are seeking a dynamic Plant Manager to lead our manufacturing operations in Bahía. This role is pivotal in driving operational excellence, ensuring safety, and delivering strong financial performance. You will oversee production processes, optimize efficiency, and inspire a team of around 500 associates to achieve ambitious goals while fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

What You'll Do

  • Shape the future of manufacturing by developing and executing strategic plans that boost efficiency, productivity, and overall performance.
  • Lead with impact by managing a diverse team of managers, supervisors, and production staff, empowering them to grow and succeed.
  • Drive results through clear KPIs, ensuring production targets, quality standards, and operational goals are consistently met.
  • Collaborate across functions with engineering, supply chain, and quality teams to deliver seamless production processes.
  • Champion safety by enforcing rigorous protocols and creating a safe, supportive environment for all associates.
  • Innovate boldly by introducing new technologies, automation, and lean methodologies to enhance operations.
  • Own the numbers by managing budgets, reducing costs, and ensuring strong financial outcomes for the site.
  • Invest in the future by designing long-term strategies for talent, equipment, and capital investments.
  • Inspire growth by mentoring plant leadership, promoting teamwork, and building a culture of accountability and excellence.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven leadership experience in manufacturing management, with at least 10 years in the field and 3+ years overseeing multiple departments.
  • Strong background in budget management, cost analysis, and resource allocation.
  • Expertise in lean manufacturing, operational excellence (OPEX), and process optimization.
  • Experience leading operations in Brazil, with deep knowledge of regulatory and safety standards.
  • Bilingual fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Exceptional communication, conflict resolution, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems, manufacturing software, and Microsoft Office.

Why Join Us

This is more than a management role—it's an opportunity to leave your mark on a growing operation. You'll be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the long-term strategy of the site, and building a high-performing team that thrives on challenge and collaboration. If you're passionate about driving results, empowering people, and transforming manufacturing, this is your chance to lead with purpose.

Esta função oferece uma empolgante posição de desenvolvimento de software na equipe de Engenharia, uma organização multicultural com times baseados na Europa e na América do Sul, responsável por pesquisar e desenvolver soluções de hardware e software para sistemas de medição de audiência utilizados globalmente.

Este profissional fará parte da equipe responsável pelos sistemas de correspondência de áudio desenvolvidos pelo IBOPE, que estão sendo implementados em diversos países. Esse sistema compara áudios coletados por dispositivos de medição dedicados com uma biblioteca de conteúdos de TV, utilizando a tecnologia proprietária de correspondência de áudio do IBOPE (técnica de fingerprinting).

O IBOPE possui sistemas desenvolvidos tanto para ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem, utilizando uma abordagem agnóstica de cloud. Sua arquitetura é composta por diversas tecnologias de ponta, como containers, Kubernetes, entre outras.



Esta função envolve:

  • Manutenção de tecnologias existentes baseadas em Linux para ambientes on-premises.
  • Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas.
  • Manutenção de pipelines.
  • Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código.



RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países.
  • Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas.
  • Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto.
  • Desenvolver novos serviços.
  • Criar novos charts do Kubernetes.
  • Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters.
  • Manter a tecnologia atual.




REQUISITOS:


Essencial:

  • Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia.
  • Experiência com Linux / bash scripting.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or Golang
  • TDD – metodologia de testes
  • Experiência com SQL database e NoSQL database.

Desejável:

  • Javascript
  • Kubernetes
  • AKS
  • Terraform
  • Monitoring systems
  • Prometheus Stack

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Join one of the most exciting early-stage platforms as we scale our engineering team globally.


You’ll be building on your full-stack experience, evolving a platform that balances cutting-edge tech with real-world stability. We are looking for a pragmatic \"builder\" who is comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and can take a feature from a raw idea to a polished delivery.


This is a 100% remote contract role (PJ) for a developer based in Brazil, reporting to our US/UK-based leadership. You’ll be central to our product delivery, working across the entire stack to ensure our users have a seamless, reliable experience.


Some of your day-to-day will be:

  • Full-Stack Development: Owning features from end-to-end using TypeScript and React.
  • Backend & Data: Building and maintaining robust services with Postgres and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Product Evolution: Supporting ongoing feature delivery and improving stability across key user flows.
  • Code Quality: Contributing to a maintainable codebase as the platform grows, balancing speed with long-term reliability.
  • Smart Engineering: Utilizing modern tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate delivery without losing sight of fundamental coding principles.


Requirements:

  • Mid-to-Senior Experience: Strong background in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React).
  • Database Fluency: Proven experience with relational databases (Postgres or similar).
  • Startup Mindset: Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment where requirements evolve.
  • Independent Operator: Able to take ownership of tasks and work autonomously to hit delivery goals.
  • Communicator: Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to collaborate with our international team.
  • Pragmatic: A focus on \"what works\" and \"what scales,\" avoiding over-engineering where it isn’t needed.


Benefits:

  • International Contract (PJ): Competitive remuneration.
  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Direct Impact: Work directly with the founding team; no layers of middle management.
  • Modern Stack: Access to the latest development tools and a clean, high-velocity environment.
  • Growth: Opportunity to grow alongside the platform as we scale.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.com.


Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

Required Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer

Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience

  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) PJ
description:
Qual será o seu papel?

  • Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente.
  • Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes.
  • Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio).
  • Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk).
  • Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD.
  • Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch).
  • Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts.


Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial):

  • Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure).
  • Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura.
  • Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure)


Contratação: PJ.

Como é trabalhar na TM?

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Aqui, precisamos de pessoas comprometidas e prontas para novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão: levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:
About SEW

SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing
  • Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms
  • 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations

SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.


Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.


The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.


This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.


Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.


Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.
  • Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations).
  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .


Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

title: Gerente de Projetos de Design
description:

A Bas-Alto é um estúdio de design full-service que opera no modelo de fractional design team : o fundador atua como design lead embedded dentro de empresas parceiras, integrado aos times e às decisões de produto e marca. A Bas-Alto é a estrutura que sustenta essa atuação: um time de designers entregando produto, web e visual design em paralelo, com o Gerente de Projetos/DesignOps garantindo que tudo opere com consistência enquanto o fundador está focado na frente estratégica. O papel central é garantir que o time de designers tenha sempre briefings claros, prioridades bem definidas e entregas organizadas, mantendo múltiplos projetos simultâneos rodando com qualidade e sem perder prazo.


Responsabilidades

  • Representar o fundador em múltiplos projetos ativos, sendo o ponto de contato entre clientes, equipe e partes interessadas
  • Traduzir necessidades e objetivos em projetos organizados, com escopo definido, prioridades claras e briefings executáveis para a equipe de design
  • Gerenciar tarefas, entregas e prazos em plataformas como ClickUp, Asana, Notion ou similares
  • Acompanhar o andamento de entregas de design (produto, web e marketing), garantindo qualidade e consistência
  • Fazer o handoff das entregas finais para os clientes, garantindo clareza, organização e um padrão elevado de apresentação
  • Comunicar com clientes no dia a dia sobre atualizações de projeto, próximos passos e alinhamentos gerais, por escrito em inglês
  • Estruturar fluxos de trabalho, cronogramas e processos internos
  • Antecipar gargalos, resolver impedimentos e manter os projetos em movimento


Necessário

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos, de preferência em estúdios de design, agências ou startups
  • Experiência sólida no setor de tecnologia e de gestão de produtos digitais
  • Familiaridade com Figma e com o universo de design: entender o que são um wireframe, um design system, uma entrega de UI ou um fluxo de UX.
  • Inglês fluente em escrita e leitura. Mais de 90% dos projetos e da comunicação do dia a dia são em inglês, incluindo termos técnicos
  • Extrema organização e atenção a detalhe para manejar múltiplas frentes ao mesmo tempo
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto com clientes quanto com a equipe
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Jira ou similares)
  • Experiência com um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico/ágil de startups


Remuneração e modelo

  • Salário: a negociar, a partir de R$ 3.600+, conforme experiência e senioridade
  • Contratação: CLT ou PJ, a negociar
  • Formato de trabalho: 100% remoto
  • Horário flexível. Obs.: É necessária disponibilidade para atender demandas também no período noturno, devido ao fuso horário de clientes da Califórnia (4h antes do Brasil).

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:
We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.

  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.

Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy.

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

Accurately communicate Hikrobot's core technology value and application advantages in the mobile robotics field through localized communication.


Customer Relationship Building & Maintenance: For key clients in the region, including system integrators, logistics automation enterprises, and large warehousing and manufacturing companies, develop and execute business development plans. Establish and deepen long-term, mutually beneficial strategic partnerships through regular visits, technical exchanges, and product training.


End-to-End Project Management: Act as the primary point of contact for clients, efficiently coordinating internal resources across R&D, delivery, and after-sales departments. Resolve commercial, technical, and delivery issues throughout the sales process, ensuring customer satisfaction and successful project implementation.


Sales Operations & Data Analysis: Proficiently use CRM and other sales tools for business process management and sales data tracking analysis. Regularly review sales activities, continuously optimize sales strategies, and ensure the efficient achievement of performance targets.


Requirements


Education: Bachelor's degree or above. Preference for majors in Automation, Mechatronics, Logistics Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, International Trade, Spanish, Portuguese, or related fields (fresh graduates are welcome).

Business Skills: Familiar with the sales process for automation projects, with proven successful cases or internship experience in collaborating with integrators or end clients (e.g., e-commerce, retail, automotive, 3C manufacturing). Possess strong market development skills, business negotiation abilities, and cross-departmental collaboration capabilities.


Core Competencies: Customer-centric, results-oriented, with strong self-motivation and a sense of responsibility. Capable of adapting to frequent overseas business trips (Latin America region) and working effectively in a multicultural environment.

Required: Fluency in business Spanish or Portuguese (able to use as a working language for business negotiations and technical exchanges).


Preferred: Proficiency in both Spanish and Portuguese is a plus; proficiency in English as a working language is also a plus.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in implementing automation equipment or AGV/AMR projects in the Latin American region (especially in Brazil or Mexico) within industries such as warehousing logistics, e-commerce, or manufacturing.


Foundational knowledge of robotics or automation, with the ability to quickly understand key technical highlights of product solutions.


Established network of automation industry clients or partners in the Latin American region.


Experience studying abroad, on exchange, or working in a Latin American country, with familiarity of local business culture and communication styles.


We Offer

Mature International System: A well-established international market expansion framework and systematic professional training to support your rapid growth.


Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary and benefits package (base salary + high commission + overseas travel allowances) along with a clear long-term career development path.


Young & Dynamic Team: An open, inclusive, and proactive team environment that encourages young professionals to take on responsibilities and quickly grow into regional business leaders.

title: Consultor SAP FI – Suporte & Sustentação
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

O profissional atuará com foco principal em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade, aderência às regras locais (Brasil e LATAM) e alinhamento com diretrizes globais. Também participará de projetos, melhorias e iniciativas de evolução do sistema, conforme demanda do negócio.


  • Contrato: Vaga temporária - Duração de 1 mês, ideal para profissionais disponíveis imediatamente, atuando com SAP FI!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Atuar prioritariamente na sustentação e suporte do SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade do ambiente e atendimento às demandas do negócio.
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes e requisições relacionadas aos processos financeiros.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Finanças e Controladoria na correta utilização do sistema.
  • Garantir aderência às regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Realizar análises funcionais detalhadas e propor soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas.
  • Configurar, testar e validar soluções no SAP FI.
  • Apoiar processos como: Fechamento contábil mensal (Month-End Close); Integrações financeiras; Especificidades fiscais brasileiras; Integrações com outros módulos SAP.
  • Identificar melhorias contínuas em processos e parametrizações.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e evidências de testes.
  • Participar de projetos de implementação, rollouts, melhorias e upgrades SAP.
  • Conduzir workshops para levantamento de requisitos quando necessário.
  • Validar e testar especificidades Brasil e LATAM durante atualizações do sistema.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de CSV para garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Assegurar qualidade e integridade dos dados financeiros no SAP.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente profissionais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Atuar como interface entre Brasil/LATAM e Headquarter para temas relacionados a SAP FI.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou melhorias SAP.
  • Conhecimento de regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Certificação SAP FI (desejável).
  • Diferencial: Conhecimento em CO.
  • Diferencial: Inglês ou espanhol


Onde você irá trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido - Curitiba/PR.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: VFX- Subject Matter Expert
description:
VFX- Fully Remote Subject Matter Expert


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting 3D Artists and VFX experts with experience creating computer generated scenes and assets to join our global network for a high level gaming project.


Rather than traditional VFX work, we are offering an opportunity to licence existing ‘on-the-shelf’ works from your archives, plus hourly compensation for technical processing.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Asset licencing: Licence existing works from your personal/ studio archives for a flat fee
  • Technical processing including rendering, layering, and preparing these files to our data specifications
  • In some cases, making variations to scenes and re-rendering


Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching


What You’ll Bring

  • Experience as a 3D, Technical or VFX Artist or Compositor in games, film or digital production
  • Experience with Unreal Engine, Unity & Houdini, Maya / Blender / Cinema4D and similar
  • Expertise in rendering, lighting and texturing
  • Comfortable using technical workflows and tools
  • Existing assets for licensing, with scenes separated into coherent, compositable layers


Nice To Have

  • Experience in the Gaming industry
  • Elements including depth, albedo, shading, gloss, cryptomat
  • Complex occlusions, atmospherics and crowd dynamics


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.



Why join this project?

This is an opportunity to licence your existing assets and to apply your expertise in VFX design on a flexible, ad hoc basis, in order to help improve AI systems for video generation with better controllability for creators.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Analista de CRM Sênior
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)



Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso? Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de CRM Sênior , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Revenue e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.



Responsabilidades


Como Analista Sênior, você será a referência técnica e estratégica do time de CRM. Seu papel será construir e manter relacionamentos estratégicos e sustentáveis entre a SuperFrete e seus clientes. Você será responsável por desenhar e implementar estratégias avançadas de personalização e comunicação, influenciando diretamente os resultados de conversão da empresa.



No dia a dia, você vai:


  • Estratégia e arquitetura de jornada: criar e implementar jornadas baseadas em dados unificados, mapeando processos de negócio para identificar gargalos e propor intervenções estratégicas que destravem valor.
  • Visão de dados: atuar na estratégia de unificação de dados dos clientes para garantir uma visão 360º, permitindo segmentações comportamentais avançadas e comunicações personalizadas.
  • Comunicação multicanal: idealizar campanhas que sejam relevantes para o momento do empreendedor, cuidando da narrativa e do impacto da mensagem em canais como WhatsApp, push, e-mail e SMS.
  • Uso estratégico do HubSpot: utilizar o potencial máximo das ferramentas de automação para viabilizar as estratégias de comunicação e otimizar as jornadas de relacionamento.
  • Experimentação e testes AB: liderar uma rotina de testes para descobrir constantemente novas alavancas de crescimento e conversão.
  • Análise e performance: monitorar KPIs de jornada e negócio através do HubSpot, Power BI e GA4, transformando dados em melhorias contínuas para a experiência do cliente.
  • Colaboração e mentoria: colaborar com as equipes de Marketing, Vendas, Produto e Atendimento para garantir a consistência dos processos; Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time de CRM compartilhando boas práticas.
  • Inovação e melhoria de processos: acompanhar tendências de mercado, propondo novas soluções tecnológicas e abordagens para escalar a personalização e aprimorar a experiência do cliente através da automação de processos.


Requisitos



  • Experiência avançada em HubSpot, com foco em automação de marketing e análise de jornada para viabilizar projetos de comunicação;
  • Domínio de estratégias de comunicação multicanal, incluindo WhatsApp, push, SMS e e-mail marketing, entendendo as particularidades e boas práticas de cada canal;
  • Habilidade em copywriting e narrativa, com capacidade de criar textos que engajam o pequeno e médio empreendedor, utilizando gatilhos e tom de voz adequados para conversão, além de desenvolver campanhas segmentadas e personalizadas com base no comportamento dos clientes;
  • Forte capacidade de análise de jornada e dados, com experiência na definição e monitoramento de KPIs de conversão e interpretação de dados para tomada de decisão;
  • Estratégia CDP & DMP: Compreensão de como a unificação de dados e a gestão de processos de negócio potencializam o CRM;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mensuração e analytics, como Appsflyer, Firebase e GA4;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos, com capacidade de estruturar e executar processos repetíveis, eficientes e escaláveis de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas.



Diferenciais


  • Experiência em startups e/ou empresas de tecnologia;


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?


  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.



O que oferecemos
